name: councilor-dino-acuna
description: Official static site for Councilor Dino Acuna of Victorias City, Negros Occidental.

scripts.//dev: Uses --ignorePattern (a regex) rather than --ignore (globs). Two reasons: live-server only compiles --ignorePattern into a real RegExp, and chokidar emits an addDir event for cms/umbraco BEFORE descending, so filtering children by glob is too late -- the SQLite WAL file, written several times a second while the CMS runs, still forces a reload. Matching the directory itself prunes the whole subtree.
scripts.//import: The content pipeline. Run in order; each step is idempotent. Run this to rebuild from dinoacuna.wordpress.com — the committed results mean it is not needed to run the site.
scripts.import:blog: npm run export:blog && npm run fetch:images && npm run fetch:editorial && npm run sync:static && npm run verify:images
